text: With m2 fixed at 0.5, suppose the paired N=64 runs (seeds 20-21) are read at the checkpoint whose val_mse_ratio matches N=128 at step 3000 (0.048-0.056). Is the N=64 minus N=128 trained force R2 gap still at least 0.04, or is the m2-fixed force drop mostly a difference in how far each run has converged?
